tool_arguments.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Create one full-body visual-novel sprite of Arlecchino expressing love-1, using only the supplied approved neutral as the image reference. Preserve her identity, face, skin tone, hair, costume, accessories, colors and rendering, and the approved neutral's body proportions. A subtle but visibly affectionate smile, open eyes, a gentle tilt of her head and one hand resting near her heart; composed yet warm. Heart eyes, hearts in eyes: both eyes visibly open, with one solid, clearly visible white heart-shaped pupil centered in each original iris. Preserve the intact iris outlines, shading and a visible colored border around each heart. The hearts are pupils, not catchlights or floating symbols. Each visible hand belongs to its own wrist and has one anatomically placed thumb and four fingers connected to one palm; fingers naturally together without forcing hidden digits into view. Keep the hands clearly separate. Exactly two legs and two feet from one pelvis, naturally posed and clearly readable. Show the entire silhouette, including hair, headwear, hands, accessories and shoes, with roughly 2–4% padding at the top and bottom. True transparent background. No scenery, text, UI, weapons, companions, floating effects, watermark or ground shadow.
